_help: Team settings for the Workload Modeller. Edit a value, save, and every user gets it on the next page load. A wrong value keeps the built-in one and the page names it. Users can still change any figure on the page for one plan. See docs/USER-GUIDE.md, 'Team settings'.
_testTypes: What a test type starts with when it is chosen on the page: load and soak hold full load for fullLoadMin minutes; stress either holds one level above the target (shape hold: levelPct % of the target for holdMin minutes) or climbs in the tool's steps (shape steps: 50, 75, 100, 125, 150%); a spike holds normal load at basePct % of the target and bursts to peakPct %.
